question_content: Which command creates a new Cloud Storage bucket?
question_cn_content: 下列哪一個指令可以建立新的 Cloud Storage 值區？
detail_explain: gcloud storage buckets create creates a bucket. Objects are uploaded with gcloud storage cp.
expert_comment:
此題要點：Cloud Storage 的指令都在 gcloud storage 底下，
值區（bucket）用 buckets create，檔案（object）用 cp 上傳。
https://cloud.google.com/sdk/gcloud/reference/storage/buckets/create

question_content: Your team runs a containerized web app that only receives traffic during class hours. You want it to scale to zero when idle and pay only for usage, with minimal operations. Which service should you use?
question_cn_content: 團隊的容器化網頁應用只在上課時段有流量。希望沒有流量時縮到零、依用量付費，而且維運工作最少，應該用哪個服務？
CN_B: (B)Compute Engine 代管執行個體群組
detail_explain: Cloud Run runs containers serverlessly, scales to zero when there are no requests, and bills for actual usage.
expert_comment: 此題要點：看到「容器」、「縮到零」、「維運最少」，第一個想到 Cloud Run。App Engine 彈性環境至少保留一個執行個體，不會縮到零。

question_content: An application on a Compute Engine VM must read objects from a single Cloud Storage bucket. Following the principle of least privilege, which TWO actions should you take?
question_cn_content: Compute Engine VM 上的應用需要讀取某一個 Cloud Storage 值區裡的檔案。依照最小權限原則，應該做哪兩件事？（選兩個）
A: (A)Attach a dedicated service account to the VM
B: (B)Grant the service account the Storage Object Viewer role on the bucket
C: (C)Create a service account key and copy it to the VM
D: (D)Grant the service account the Owner role on the project
F: (F)Use the default Compute Engine service account with the Editor role
CN_A: (A)為 VM 附加一個專用的服務帳戶
CN_B: (B)在值區上授予該服務帳戶 Storage Object Viewer 角色
CN_C: (C)建立服務帳戶金鑰並複製到 VM
CN_D: (D)在專案上授予該服務帳戶 Owner 角色
CN_F: (F)使用預設的 Compute Engine 服務帳戶並給 Editor 角色
detail_explain: Use a dedicated service account attached to the VM, and grant only the role it needs, scoped to the bucket. Avoid keys, broad roles, and public access.
expert_comment: 此題要點：服務身分＋最小範圍的角色，不用金鑰。這也是小幫手本身的做法。

question_content: Which TWO Cloud Storage classes have a minimum storage duration of 90 days or more?
question_cn_content: 下列哪兩種 Cloud Storage 儲存類別的最短儲存期限是 90 天以上？（選兩個）
detail_explain: Nearline: 30 days, Coldline: 90 days, Archive: 365 days. Standard has no minimum storage duration.
